What is the White Land Tax? The White Land Tax was introduced in 2015 as part of Saudi Arabia’s plan to tackle one of its most persistent problems: unused land within cities. title: Vibe Coding: The End of Manual Programming?
text: Think of it as “prompt-driven software development.” You describe what you want (“Build a REST API for user onboarding with JWT auth and PostgreSQL”), and the AI generates the structure, boilerplate, and even business logic — continuously refining it as you chat. 💡 The “vibe” part comes from how fluid and conversational the process is — it’s like “vibing” with your AI pair programmer. title: Saudi Arabia Education System: The Powerful Evolving Journey
text: Education isn’t just about classrooms, chalkboards, or uniforms. It’s about the story of how a nation decides to raise its children, nurture its thinkers, and shape its future. The Saudi Arabia education system has been undergoing a quiet yet powerful transformation—one that blends tradition with ambition, heritage with innovation. To understand education in Saudi Arabia today is to glimpse the vision of a country that has decided knowledge should be its most significant investment. At the center of it all stands the Ministry of Education KSA , driving reforms, modernizing approaches, and reshaping what it means to learn in the Kingdom. Let’s take a closer look at how education in KSA has evolved, what it offers today, and why students—both Saudi and international—are increasingly drawn to study in Saudi . Learning was personal, intimate, and deeply rooted in Islamic tradition. But as the world changed, Saudi Arabia changed with it. The Saudi Ministry of Education became the driving force behind creating a unified national curriculum, establishing public schools, and ensuring that education was accessible to both boys and girls nationwide. It sets policies, designs curricula, and ensures that Saudi Arabia’s learners are equipped for the world beyond its borders. Sets frameworks for international collaboration in higher education. Promotes digital learning and e-education. Provides opportunities, such as the Saudi Government Scholarship program, which opens doors for students to study abroad. And beyond policies, the Saudi Ministry of Education is deeply involved in ensuring education supports Vision 2030 , the Kingdom’s ambitious roadmap for diversification and growth.
